2609.08244.title: CUNO: Curriculum and Preference Optimization for Stable Graph Unlearning under Mass Deletion
2609.08244.paper_summary: Graph unlearning removes the influence of designated training data from a trained graph model without retraining from scratch. However, existing methods suffer a sharp drop in model utility under large deletion ratios (mass deletion), a phenomenon we refer to as catastrophic unlearning. We find that a key cause is the uniform treatment of all deleted samples, which is particularly damaging in graph learning: structural dependencies cause different nodes to play vastly different roles in the learned model, yet existing methods apply the same forgetting operation to the entire forget set. Based on this insight, we propose CUNO, a curriculum-based graph unlearning framework that removes the forget set progressively, ordering samples by their estimated unlearning difficulty across multiple stages. CUNO further employs a distribution-level negative preference optimization (NPO) objective at each curriculum stage that steers the model away from its original behavior on the current forget subset while preserving retained performance. Our theoretical analysis shows that the curriculum design is most beneficial when the forget set spans a wide range of unlearning difficulty, a condition naturally satisfied under mass deletion. Comprehensive experiments confirm that CUNO consistently mitigates catastrophic unlearning: at 20% deletion, it retains 74% of the original utility compared to 26-53% for existing methods, and maintains more than half the original utility even at 50% deletion. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cuno-D4FF.
2609.08244.paper_summary_zh: 圖形去學習在不從頭開始重新訓練的情況下，去除訓練圖形模型中指定訓練數據的影響。<lb/>然而，現有方法在大刪除比率（大規模刪除）下會遭遇模型效用的急劇下降，我們將這一現象稱為災難性去學習。<lb/>我們發現，一個主要原因是對所有刪除樣本的統一處理，這在圖形學習中尤其有害：結構依賴性使得不同節點在學習的模型中扮演著截然不同的角色，然而現有方法對整個遺忘集應用相同的遺忘操作。<lb/>基於這一見解，我們提出了CUNO，一個基於課程的圖形去學習框架，該框架逐步去除遺忘集，根據樣本在多個階段中的預估去學習難度進行排序。<lb/>CUNO在每個課程階段進一步採用分佈級別的負偏好優化（NPO）目標，旨在使模型遠離當前遺忘子集的原始行為，同時保持保留的性能。<lb/>我們的理論分析表明，當遺忘集涵蓋廣泛的去學習難度時，課程設計最具益處，而這一條件在大規模刪除下自然滿足。<lb/>全面的實驗證實CUNO能夠持續減輕災難性去學習：在20%的刪除下，與現有方法的26-53%相比，它保留了74%的原始效用，並且即使在50%的刪除下也保持了超過一半的原始效用。<lb/>我們的代碼已公開提供於 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cuno-D4FF。
